experience.title: Inventory Operations Coordinator
bullets: Managed manual weighing logs for incoming freight, tracking discrepancies that recurred when handwritten records didn't match scale readings.
Grew frustrated with recurring downtime on the warehouse's shared Windows terminals, and began teaching myself scripting to diagnose recurring failures.

projects.title: Automaticweighingsystem
bullets: Built a C# application to automate freight weighing logs, replacing the handwritten process from a previous logistics role.
Structured the implementation across 162 files over 18 commits, translating a familiar manual workflow into working software.

projects.title: PF.UI
bullets: Wrote a C# and batch-scripting utility spanning 757 files, extending the systems-administration skills first sparked by warehouse terminal troubleshooting.
Tested the utility's behavior across a small Linux server environment to build confidence before wider use.
